description:
src/filenode.rs:307-353: the rename loop iterates suffix 1..=100, calling find_sibling_by_name once per suffix. Worst case: 100 sequential backend calls (each typically a DB query) just to construct one create_id's name.

For high-collision scenarios — e.g., a shared 'untitled' import folder where many siblings start as 'untitled-N' — the worst case is the common case. 100 sequential round-trips at ~1ms each = 100ms latency per create entry. A /set request with 50 creates colliding similarly = 5 seconds.

Per the trait, find_sibling_by_name is the only collision primitive. The handler has no way to ask 'give me a unique name efficiently'.

Suggested fix: add a new backend method find_unique_name(parent_id, base_name, case_insensitive) -> Result<String, _> that the backend implements with a single query (e.g., 'SELECT name FROM filenodes WHERE parent_id = ? AND name LIKE ?' then compute the next free suffix from the result). Default impl falls back to the current loop for backends that do not override.

The 100-attempt cap also has no spec basis — it is a workspace choice. Surfacing as 'serverFail: could not find unique name after 100 attempts' is user-hostile and Section 4 will flag the error message. The fix should remove the artificial cap when a single-query find_unique_name is available.
title: FileNode/set OnExists::Rename: O(100) sequential backend round-trips for collision retry
